author: Roxana Tiron, Patrick Sykes
description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth rejected the idea of an “endless” war with Iran as airstrikes continued for a third day, with the conflict reverberating across the Middle East and upending energy markets.
title: US Insists Iran War Won’t Be Endless as Strikes Engulf Region

description: The US goal for Trump’s Iran strikes? Everything, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Marc Champion explains. Success can now come only with regime change. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran Is Trump’s Biggest Gamble Yet

author: Daryna Krasnolutska
description: Volodymyr Zelenskiy offered to send his best experts in shooting down Iranian drones to the Middle East if leaders there convince Vladimir Putin to agree to a month-long truce in Russia’s war on Ukraine.
title: Zelenskiy Offers Help to Stop Iranian Drones In Return for Truce

description: The US, Iran conflict escalates as President Trump signals prolonged bombing campaign and demands Iranian capitulation. Meanwhile, Tehran’s top security official flatly rejects negotiations. Bloomberg's Dan Williams joins Bloomberg Open Interest from Jerusalem to talk about the latest developments. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says Iran Bombing Could Last Weeks

author: Peter Martin, Fiona MacDonald, Ellen Milligan
description: A British base in Cyprus struck by a drone. A French facility in Abu Dhabi targeted. A base hosting Italian troops in Kuwait hit. Saudi oil facilities attacked as ships queue outside the Strait of Hormuz. Missiles over Bahrain and Qatar. Gulf airspace shut down.
title: Trump’s Iran War Widens, Forcing Reluctant Allies to Choose

author: Greg Stohr
description: The US Supreme Court steered clear of the politically charged fray over state voting rolls, rejecting two appeals from a conservative group that sought broader access to election data in Pennsylvania and Michigan.
title: Supreme Court Rejects Group’s Bid to See More State Voter Data

author: Greg Stohr
description: The US Supreme Court declined to consider restoring the gun rights of people convicted of nonviolent felonies, turning away an appeal from a Utah woman convicted 18 years ago of trying to pass a bad check at a grocery store.
title: Supreme Court Rebuffs Nonviolent Felon Gun-Rights Appeal

author: Ania Nussbaum, Gerry Doyle, Max Ramsay
description: President Emmanuel Macron said France will boost its nuclear arsenal as US security commitments to Europe waver.
title: France to Boost Nuclear Arsenal With US Commitments in Doubt

description: Three US fighter jets crashed after being mistakenly shot down by Kuwaiti air defenses, though all six aircrew ejected safely. Footage shared online, and not independently verified by Bloomberg, showed people parachuting out of planes. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Three US Warplanes Crash in Kuwait After "Friendly Fire" Incident

author: Anthony Capaccio
description: The Chinese Navy has “dramatically increased” submarine production and could soon deploy a new vessel that’s able to hit “large portions” of the US with nuclear missiles from Chinese waters, according to the head of intelligence for the US Navy.
title: China Boosts Output of Advanced Nuclear-Armed Subs, US Navy Says

author: Foster Wong
description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi called on Iran to pay attention to the “reasonable concerns” of its neighbors, after Tehran’s retaliation against US and Israeli attacks included strikes on other Gulf nations.
title: China Urges Iran to Consider ‘Reasonable Concerns’ of Neighbors

description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth gives an update on Operation Epic Fury in a press conference Monday at the Pentagon. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Mission Is Focused on Destroying Iran’s Missiles, Navy, Hegseth Says

author: Slav Okov
description: Bulgaria’s former President Rumen Radev took the first formal step to running in the next general election in a bid to end the Balkan nation’s years-long political turmoil.
title: Bulgaria’s Ex-President Launches Coalition to Run in Snap Vote

author: Roxana Tiron, Anthony Capaccio
description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth rejected the idea that the war against Iran would be the sort of endless conflict that President Donald Trump swore to avoid when he took office a second time, saying “our generation knows better.”
title: Hegseth Denies That Iran Campaign Will Turn Into Endless War

description: The US says three fighter jets were downed in “friendly fire” over Kuwait as strikes across the Middle East continued for a third day. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran Crisis Latest: US Fighter Jets Downed in Kuwait

author: Anthony Halpin
description: Russia and Ukraine still expect planned US-led peace talks to take place this week, even as President Donald Trump’s administration continues a military campaign against Iran.
title: Russia, Ukraine Plan for US-Led Peace Talks Despite War in Iran

author: Kok Leong Chan, Netty Idayu Ismail
description: A proposed amendment to Malaysia’s constitution to limit the prime minister’s tenure to 10 years has failed to garner the two-thirds majority support of lawmakers.
title: Malaysia’s Bid to Limit Prime Minister’s Tenure Fails Vote

description: Bloomberg Opinion's Marc Chamipon has been writing about the widening war in the Middle East. In his piece he says  "US President Donald Trump never did explain to Congress or anyone else what his justifications and goals would be for attacking Iran. Now, with "Operation Epic Fury" underway, we know. The answer was "everything". Marc says that makes this a gamble on a scale way beyond anything even this former casino owner has done before. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Goals For Iran Are Clear - It Wants Everything: Marc Champion

author: Alex Wickham
description: President Donald Trump criticized UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer for initially blocking the US from using British military bases in its operations against Iran.
title: Trump Scolds Starmer for UK’s Reluctance to Support Iran Strikes

author: Aliaksandr Kudrytski
description: A protracted war in the Middle East could reduce the availability of air defenses for Ukraine, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said, acknowledging potential ripple effects from the US-led bombing campaign in Iran.
title: Zelenskiy Says Long Iran Conflict Would Hurt Ukraine Air Defense

author: Emily Birnbaum
description: Conservative critics of online prediction markets are launching a new advocacy group to fight Trump administration efforts to keep the platforms free of state gambling regulations, bringing new firepower to forces opposing the industry in a pivotal political battle.
title: Prediction Market Critics Step Up Fight With New Advocacy Group

description: Israel opened up a new front in the Middle East conflict, with an official offensive against Hezbollah in Lebanon. That's after the group fired rockets towards Israel in retaliation for the killing of Iran's supreme leader. Bloomberg's Dan Williams reports from Jerusalem. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Israel Launches Offensive Against Hezbollah in Lebanon

author: Mirette Magdy
description: Shippers are once again avoiding the Suez Canal as the US and Israel are locked in a war with Iran, dashing hopes of an imminent revival for the key global trade conduit that’s a pillar of the Egyptian economy.
title: Hopes for Suez Canal Revival Dashed by New Middle East Conflict

author: Patrick Sykes
description: The Islamic Republic faces a choice between continuity or a more moderate figure prepared to compromise.
title: Iran’s Hardliners Won’t Easily Be Dislodged

author: Antony Sguazzin
description: Sandile Buthelezi, the director-general of South Africa’s Department of Health, has been arrested and charged with fraud along with an acting deputy director general and the department’s chief financial officer.
title: South Africa Says Three Senior Health Officials Have Been Arrested

author: Josh Xiao
description: US President Donald Trump’s assault on Iran has killed the country’s supreme leader and left it burning through missiles, but there’s little sign Tehran can count on Beijing to bolster its defenses.
title: China Showing Few Signs It Will Directly Supply Arms to Iran

author: Carolina Gonzalez
description: As Chile prepares to swear in its most radical free-market government in over 35 years, many analysts and traders can’t drag their attention away from the US, Iran and President Donald Trump.
title: Chile Preps for Political Seachange as Markets Focus on Trump

description: Jasmine El-Gamal, a former Middle East adviser to the Pentagon, says the "narrow objective" of Iran's leadership amid the ongoing US-Iran military operation is the survival of the regime. The Islamic Republic has been "planning for this scenario probably for years," El-Gamal tells Bloomberg Television. "Contrast that to Donald Trump," she adds. "No objective, no road map on how to get there, no legal foundation for this because there was no imminent threat to the US." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran's 'Narrow Objective' Is Regime Survival, Analyst Says

description: Jeff Currie, Chief Strategy Officer of Energy Pathways at Carlyle, discusses the impact of escalating conflicts in the Middle East. "The risks are to the upside," Currie tells Bloomberg Television. He adds that "the hoarding situation" is going to become more extreme. Oil tankers are hunkering down inside the Persian Gulf after attacks near the Strait of Hormuz have all but closed off the waterway. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Jeff Currie Says Risks to Energy Supply Chains Never Been Higher

author: Donato Paolo Mancini
description: Italy didn’t manage to meet the European Union’s 3% deficit ceiling last year, an unexpected setback for Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s government.
title: Italy’s Deficit Breached EU’s 3% Ceiling in 2025 After All

author: Bilal Hussain
description: At least 24 people were killed in protests outside several US consulates across Pakistan on Sunday, prompting authorities to impose a curfew in some regions to quell the anger against the killing of Iran’s top leader.
title: Pakistan Death Toll Climbs to 24 as Pro-Iran Protests Target US

author: Philip Glamann
description: Beijing said Washington gave the government no advance warning of its attack on Iran, as it called for an immediate end to the hostilities.
title: China Says US Didn’t Give It Any Notice Before Attacking Iran

author: Christine Burke
description: For almost three days, there was little sign of a new war raging in the Gulf if you were based in Saudi Arabia. Most schools were business as usual on Monday morning, Saudis and foreigners reported heading to the office and carrying on with meetings, and flights continue to shuffle people into, out of and across the country.
title: Saudis Pulled Deeper Into Mideast War After Refinery Attack

description:
Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. 

On today's show, US President Donald Trump says the bombing campaign against Iran will continue until objectives are achieved. Meanwhile, Iran’s National Security Chief says his country won’t negotiate with the US.

Stocks sold off and oil prices jumped as conflict in the Middle East jolted global markets, triggering a broad retreat from risk assets. Gold and the dollar rose in haven demand.

Travel chaos is extending through the Middle East and beyond. Carriers across the Persian Gulf have extended blanket flight suspensions, causing major disruptions at some of the world's busiest airports.

Today's guests: Former US Ambassador to Israel and Atlantic Council Distinguished Fellow Daniel Shapiro, Vanda Insights Founder, Vandana Hari & Xeneta Chief Analyst Peter Sand. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US-Israel Iran Strikes Latest: Trump Says Iran Operations To Continue | Daybreak Europe 03/2/2026

description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said strikes on Iran will “only increase” in the coming days. He made his comments in a video statement made while standing on the roof of IDF headquarters in Tel Aviv. Meanwhile, Israeli forces announced a fresh round of strikes on Iranian-funded Hezbollah in Lebanon. Bloomberg’s Dan Williams reports.
title: Netanyahu Says Israeli Strikes on Iran to ‘Increase’

author: Rajesh Kumar Singh, Brian Platt
description: Canadian firm Cameco Corp. signed a C$2.6 billion ($1.9 billion) uranium supply deal with India on Monday during Prime Minister Mark Carney’s first official visit to the country.
title: Canada’s Cameco Signs $1.9 Billion Uranium Deal With India

author: Patrick Sykes, Kateryna Kadabashy
description: US President Donald Trump said the bombing campaign against Iran could last for weeks and called on the nation’s leaders to capitulate, while the Islamic Republic’s security chief ruled out negotiations.
title: Trump Pushes for New Iran Leadership as Tehran Stays Defiant

description: Oil surged by the most in four years as traders gauged the impact of the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz as the conflict between the US and Iran continues.  Iranian authorities said on Sunday that the key waterway remained open, they also said they had attacked three oil tankers. In reaction to the widening conflict, OPEC+ agreed at a pre-arranged weekend meeting to raise quotas next month by 206,000 barrels a day. Bloomberg’s Anthony di Paola breaks down the situation.
title: Oil Price Surges as US-Iran Conflict Continues

description: Explosions were seen in Lebanon's capital as the Israeli army said it struck senior Hezbollah militants in the Beirut area and in southern Lebanon. The attacks have caused mass displacement, according to the Lebanese state-run news agency NNA. (Source: Associated Press)
title: Explosions in Beirut as Israel Attacks Hezbollah Targets

description: US President Donald Trump said the bombing campaign against Iran will continue until “all our objectives are achieved.” He called on the nation’s leaders to capitulate as a report indicated at least one top official in Tehran sought to resume nuclear talks with the US. The conflict is spreading across the Middle East as Iran sends waves of missiles at targets in multiple countries that host US military facilities. Bloomberg’s Joumanna Bercetche reports.
title: Trump Sees Combat in Iran Until All Objectives Achieved

author: Claire Jiao, Neil Jerome Morales
description: Millions of migrant workers, who support some of the Middle East’s most crucial sectors, are in the line of fire as Iran retaliates against the US-Israeli strikes that killed the Islamic Republic’s supreme leader.
title: Millions of Migrant Workers in Gulf at Risk as War Rages On

author: Sudhi Ranjan Sen, Brian Platt
description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi pledged to boost cooperation in trade and supply chains during Carney’s first official visit to India, as the two nations look to reset relations following years of strain.
title: Carney Meets Modi in New Delhi, Marking New Chapter in Ties

author: Tom Rees
description: Chancellor of the Exchequer Rachel Reeves has been given a £22 billion ($30 billion) windfall ahead of her spring update this week, an unexpected boost as she seeks to show her efforts to stabilize the public finances are working.
title: Reeves Reaps £22 Billion Windfall as Britain’s Tax Take Surges

author: Sarina Yoo
description: North Korea condemned Israel’s military attack on Iran with US military support as a “shameless” and illegal act of aggression.
title: North Korea Slams US, Israel Over ‘Shameless’ Strike on Iran

author: Peter Vercoe
description: Emirates and Qatar Airways are among the worst-affected airlines as the conflict in Iran shutters airports across the Middle East, throwing the global aviation industry into chaos.
title: The Airports and Airlines Disrupted by US-Iran Conflict

author: Manuela Tobias
description: Emboldened by a string of legislative victories, President Javier Milei dedicated Argentina’s annual state of the nation address to hurling insults at his opponents in a return to his boisterous persona on the campaign trail.
title: Milei Hurls Insults in Divisive Speech to Argentina’s Congress

author: Erica Yokoyama, Akemi Terukina
description: Artificial intelligence could upend Japan’s labor market and swell the ranks of those subsisting on low incomes, creating the need for targeted policy support, the leader of an upstart opposition party focused on the implications of technology said.
title: AI May Swell Japan’s Lower-Income Ranks, Party Leader Warns

author: Sherif Tarek
description: Hezbollah attacked Israel in retaliation for the killing of Iran’s supreme leader, reemerging as a potential proxy threat that prompted Israel to respond forcefully.
title: Hezbollah Fires on Israel in Response to Khamenei’s Death

description: On a special edition of "Balance of Power" we focus the US and Israel's attack on Iran which could lead to a surge in energy prices, further conflict and a nightmare scenario for neighboring Gulf countries. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US, Israel Conflict With Iran | Balance of Show 3/1/2026

description: Rep. Madeleine Dean, a Democrat from Pennsylvania and a member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, says President Donald Trump did not make the case to Congress or the American people on his objectives for military action against Iran. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran Attack Is a ‘War of Choice’ for Trump, Rep. Dean Says
